turns.text: Sam: Passing this on from the platform channel: we're moving the nightly jobs to 02:00 UTC instead of shrinking the backup window, so the two stop colliding. I don't know who signed it off.

captures.title: Move the nightly jobs to 02:00 UTC
captures.rationale: The nightly jobs and the backup window stop colliding, and moving the jobs avoids shrinking the backup window.
